content.text: An illustrated audiobook of the myth of Orpheus and Eurydice: a narrator tells the whole story over a slideshow of painted illustrations, with Orpheus, Eurydice, and Hades each speaking their own lines of dialogue woven into the narration — a richer, multi-voice dramatic telling (not a one-line-per-page children's book). Gentle read-aloud English narration, English subtitles, and foley.
